music: W. A. Mozart, Symphony No. 40 in G minor, K. 550, IV. Allegro assai — Musopen Kickstarter recording (CC0)
note: phrases: the attack (onset) of every two-bar phrase of the movement's opening, the piano rocket and the forte answer in turn; each starts one film bar. ending: the coda's attacks one film bar apart; the last is the final chord, which lands on bar 18 with the end card's glint.
